thread:
sam (support): Heads-up — NovusCare dropped a compliance packet in Zendesk #8421. They want SOC2 evidence, HIPAA BAA, EU retention 7 years, and customer KMS/HSM. They asked for timeline for Private/Dedicated deploy + audit logs export. Link: https://zendesk.example/tickets/8421 :eyes:
raj (sales): Are they a deal-in-flight? how firm on the 7-year ask? cc @maria
maria (product): Deal is in POC stage per account execs. We need to triage this to backlog and negotiate scope. My proposal: capture as an "enterprise-compliance-intake - NovusCare" epic, then break into phased deliverables. Quick q: do we need to promise 7-year retention to close?
raj (sales): Procurement wrote that 7 years is a hard req for Europe regulators, probably non-negotiable. They said deployment by end of Q3 to meet procurement timelines.
olivia (security): Quick notes: SOC2 evidence = mostly docs + config exports we already have. HIPAA requires signed BAA (legal). The tricky bits: long-term retention (7y) for audit logs and PII retention policy; and customer-managed KMS with HSM-level key control. For KMS, our Private offering can support customer key import or external KMS. For hosted, we'd need a design + legal review.
kevin (eng): Rough eng estimates: archival pipeline to move logs to cold storage + lifecycle policy ~3w, UI to set retention per-customer ~2w, KMS integration + key rotation support ~2w, export formats & compliance export endpoints ~1w. Total ~8w engineering work, assuming no surprises.
maria (product): OK — propose we split into phases: M1 (evidence + BAA + audit docs + short-term retention to 1 year with export), M2 (private/KMS options + retention UI + archival pipeline for 7y), M3 (automated compliance export + docs + acceptance tests). Launch criteria for each phase should be explicit.
sam (support): I'll ack the customer and give an initial timeline: "We can support immediate SOC2 evidence and BAA; retention/KMS features are on a prioritized roadmap — ETA 8–12 weeks for Private + retention options. We'll provide interim export to meet procurement if needed"
maria (product): Draft acceptance criteria I'm adding to the ticket: 1) BAA signed and legal confirmed. 2) Exportable audit package (logs + config) within 24h. 3) Retention policy configurable to 7 years and enforced (archival to cold storage). 4) Customer KMS integration validated (HSM-backed). 5) Integration test proves encrypted-at-rest with customer keys. 6) Docs + runbook delivered. Any adjustments?
olivia (security): Add: threat model update and control mapping for SOC2 scope; also a proof-of-deletion policy for retained data (how we handle legal holds). We'll need legal to verify retention periods.
kevin (eng): Add performance/egress cost estimate for 7y retention (storage + retrieval). Also need to confirm log schema and PII classification to decide what to archive.
raj (sales): Sounds good. I'll push procurement for flexibility on timeline; ask if they can accept a signed roadmapped commitment with milestone dates.
maria (product): I'll create the epic and initial child tickets. Naming: `ENT-8421-novuscare-compliance`. Acceptance tests will live in `qa/compliance/ENT-8421`. Can @kevin + @olivia review estimates and I'll drop story points tomorrow. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: New ticket created in JIRA: `ENT-8421` -> https://jira.example/browse/ENT-8421
sam (support): Customer update: "Thanks — we can provide SOC2 artifacts and a BAA today. For retention and KMS, we will follow up with a roadmap and estimated delivery window."
maria (product): Action items: (1) create epic `ENT-8421` (done), (2) assign security review to @olivia, (3) eng spike for KMS options -> assign to @kevin, (4) legal to start BAA draft (sam to loop in legal). I'll post triage notes to the thread and mark P1.
olivia (security): I'll draft control mapping and hit legal for retention constraints. Expect initial feedback in 48–72h.
kevin (eng): I'll spin up a quick spike for AWS KMS + on-prem HSM options, and prototype an archival proof-of-concept into Glacier. ETA 2w for spike.
maria (product): Great — capturing conversation and next steps in `ENT-8421` comments. We should also decide negotiation posture: offer immediate BAA + export, and ship retention/KMS in paid Private plan as prioritized deliverable. That keeps deal momentum while not overpromising hosted changes.
raj (sales): Agreed. I'll propose that to procurement and escalate if they insist on hosted-level guarantees.
sam (support): Noted. Closing loop: I'll attach Zendesk #8421 export to the JIRA ticket.
maria (product): Thanks all. We'll reconvene after security spike results. :wave:
